title: Nanbeige Releases 33B Parameter Model With State-of-the-Art Agentic Performance
summary:
A new open dense model targeting the performance ceiling of AI agents is now available from Nanbeige. The Nanbeige4.3-33B features approximately 30B parameters and is designed for state-of-the-art agentic performance among open models, with specific strengths in agentic coding and cowork benchmarks.

The model will serve as a teacher to train smaller versions, beginning with the Nanbeige4.3-3B. When integrated into mainstream agent harnesses, the developer says the system handles real-world tasks using cost-efficient inference.

🚀Excited to announce Nanbeige4.3-33B!
To push the performance ceiling of small agents, our strategy in Nanbeige4.3 starts with building a powerful teacher first.
Nanbeige4.3-33B delivers SOTA agentic performance among open models at ~30B parameters:
* Strong results on agentic coding and cowork benchmarks.
*  When integrated into mainstream agent harnesses, it tackles real-world tasks with cost-efficient inference.
*  It will serve as a teacher for upcoming smaller Nanbeige models, starting with Nanbeige4.3-3B.
